eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 25 · Joining Tables

code:
SELECT p.Name, sod.SalesOrderID, sod.OrderQty
FROM Production.Product AS p
FULL OUTER JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
    ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID;
caption: Every row from BOTH tables — NULL-filled wherever a match is missing, on either side.

code:
SELECT p.Name, sod.SalesOrderID
FROM Production.Product AS p
FULL OUTER JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod
    ON p.ProductID = sod.ProductID
WHERE p.ProductID IS NULL
   OR sod.ProductID IS NULL;
caption: One query catches unmatched rows from both sides at once.

subtitle: The join with no ON clause at all.
